text:
### Observed differences

In the later window, activity A02 was observed in about 12 in 100 traces, up from about 3 in 100 before; its mean occurrences per trace rose from 0.03 to 0.115. Recurrence of A02 within a trace was not observed in either window. [OCC001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. Only one evidence item was flagged, while about 0.44 items would be expected by chance alone if nothing had changed, so this single increase is within the range an unchanged process can produce. [OCC001]
